svg.title: Commit rhythm: weekday by hour
svg.desc: A 7 by 24 heatmap of 882 real commit timestamps in Asia/Kolkata. Busiest slot is Sun at 1:00 with 26 commits. 24 percent of commits land between 11pm and 6am, 45 percent on weekends.
svg.text: busiest slot Sun 01:00 with 26 commits · 24% land 23:00-06:00 · 45% on weekends
